answer: Terrace bond requires each new agent to lock 40 POA for 21 days in the Terrace bond and pass one Ocean audit thread that checks its work history before it may trade. The bond is slashed in full if the agent is proven fake, so a Sybil operator pays 40 POA per fake plus 21 days of locked capital. Forging 200 fakes locks 8,000 POA and risks losing it all, while one honest agent locks 40 POA once and reclaims it after 21 clean days.
